With eight bedrooms, an optional ninth bedroom or office, four full bathrooms, a powder room, and three levels of living space, the home is designed to accommodate large gatherings, extended family, and guests without sacrificing comfort or privacy. This level also includes a guest bedroom, a full bathroom, a powder room, and a laundry room.  Upper Level  The primary suite overlooks the coastline and features a fireplace, private oceanfront deck, and panoramic views of the Pacific. Just beyond the deck, the property's private sandy beach provides a setting unlike virtually any other home in Oceanside. Spend evenings around the fire pit, enjoy the sound of the waves just steps away, or walk down your private stairs for direct access to the public beach and surf.  A thoughtfully designed lock-off configuration between the main and upper levels offers flexibility for extended family, guests, or a variety of living arrangements. Quiet, green, private, and just four miles from the ocean — a particularly special setting.

results.remarks: Seller will entertain offers between $1,399,888-$1,499,888. Sweeping panoramic views of the ocean, harbor, river, and mountains create breathtaking vistas day and night from this exceptional beach condo. The enlarged kitchen is a showstopper featuring quartz countertops, a farmhouse sink, high-end GE Café matte black appliances, a double-drawer dishwasher, and recessed lighting. The contemporary living area offers a rich cognac leather sofa bed, two barrel chairs, and a striking stacked-stone fireplace surround—perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Retreat to the primary ocean view suite with a stunning updated bath and walk-in closet, while the expansive upper balcony functions as an additional living space with dining and comfortable seating. North Coast Village offers an unbeatable resort-style lifestyle, complete with two heated pools and spas, putting green, ocean-view BBQ area, and lush tropical landscaping throughout. Stay active in the fully equipped gym, unwind in the saunas, and enjoy the peace of mind that comes with 24-hour gated and guarded security. Reserved garage parking is also included. Best of all, this home is being sold fully furnished, making it a true turnkey opportunity to embrace the beach lifestyle.  North Coast Village offers a wealth of amenities, including billiards, table tennis, a fitness center with saunas, tranquil Koi ponds, and a barbecue area overlooking the pool—perfect for gatherings. The community consists of charming 4-story buildings and 2-story cottages, all set amidst lush, tropical landscaping. This oceanfront oasis is just steps from the sand, ideal for romantic strolls along one of Southern California's most beautiful beaches. Residents enjoy reserved garage parking, cable TV, a recreation center, and a clubhouse complete with a kitchen, massive stone fireplace, cedar walls, and convenient laundry facilities. Nestled between Oceanside Harbor and Oceanside Pier, the location is a haven for outdoor enthusiasts, with scenic biking trails starting across the street and the historic Pacific Coast Highway nearby. Delight in spectacular sunsets, waterfront dining at the harbor, live music, and unique shopping. Adventure awaits with kayak, boat, and paddle boat rentals, fishing, and whale-watching excursions. Downtown Oceanside is a vibrant destination, boasting exciting new restaurants, hotels, and a lively atmosphere. Don’t miss the Main Street Oceanside Farmers' Market every Thursday morning for fresh produce or the Sunset Market Thursday evenings, offering international food booths and live entertainment. Embrace the laid-back coastal lifestyle of Oceanside!

Inside, the bright and welcoming floor plan is designed for comfortable daily living. Fresh updates throughout mean you can move in and begin enjoying the home right away instead of planning your next renovation. On warm afternoons, spend your time at the community pool instead of maintaining a yard.  Whether you’re purchasing your first home, looking for a comfortable place to downsize, or searching for a move-in-ready coastal retreat, 3614 Harvard Drive Unit B stands out for its location, easy-care lifestyle, and three private outdoor spaces. If you’ve been waiting for a home that gives you more ways to enjoy life outside and less to maintain, this one deserves a place at the top of your list.

results.remarks: Oceanfront Estate on the Sand | 1409 South Pacific Street | Oceanside, California  Seller Financing Available for Qualified Buyers  Opportunities like this are exceptionally rare. At the time of listing, 1409 South Pacific Street is the only single-family home available directly on the sand in Oceanside.  The 1400 block of South Pacific Street is one of Oceanside's most sought-after oceanfront locations. With no homes across the street and only a handful of beachfront residences, the neighborhood offers a quieter, less-traveled setting while remaining just minutes from the harbor, restaurants, shopping, and downtown.  Unlike most Southern California beachfront properties, this residence includes a private sandy beach within the parcel boundaries—an extraordinary ownership feature rarely found along the California coast. The private beach becomes a natural extension of the home, creating an outdoor living experience that few properties can offer.  With eight bedrooms, an optional ninth bedroom or office, four full bathrooms, a powder room, and three levels of living space, the home is designed to accommodate large gatherings, extended family, and guests without sacrificing comfort or privacy.  A portion of the home is currently operated as a successful short-term rental. The current short-term rental permit does not convey with the sale. Buyers are advised to verify permit availability, licensing requirements, and all applicable regulations with the City of Oceanside.  Main Level  The kitchen, dining area, and great room are all oriented toward the Pacific, allowing the ocean to become the focal point of everyday living. Sliding doors open to an oceanfront deck, creating an effortless transition between indoor and outdoor spaces. This level also includes a guest bedroom, a full bathroom, a powder room, and a laundry room.  Upper Level  The primary suite overlooks the coastline and features a fireplace, private oceanfront deck, and panoramic views of the Pacific. Three additional bedrooms, a flexible office or media room, and a conveniently located laundry closet complete the upper level.  Beach Level  Created for entertaining and relaxed coastal living, the beach level offers three bedrooms, a full bathroom, an efficiency kitchen, a beach bar with sink and wine refrigerator, a fireplace, and a spacious gathering room that opens directly onto the oceanfront deck.  Just beyond the deck, the property's private sandy beach provides a setting unlike virtually any other home in Oceanside. Spend evenings around the fire pit, enjoy the sound of the waves just steps away, or walk down your private stairs for direct access to the public beach and surf.  A thoughtfully designed lock-off configuration between the main and upper levels offers flexibility for extended family, guests, or a variety of living arrangements.  Nearly 400 square feet of oceanfront decking creates multiple outdoor spaces for dining, relaxing, and taking in the ever-changing coastline, while abundant storage throughout the home enhances everyday functionality.  Additional Features  * Seller financing available for qualified buyers * Private sandy beach within the parcel boundaries * Oceanfront decks on multiple levels * Lock-off floor plan * Single-car garage * Carport plus additional off-street parking * Negotiable furnishings * No HOA * No special assessments  Located just minutes from Oceanside's harbor, restaurants, boutique shopping, and coastal attractions, this home combines one of Southern California's most desirable beachfront settings with the convenience of a vibrant coastal community.  Properties like this seldom come to market. Directly on the sand, a private beach within the property's boundaries, one of the largest single-family oceanfront homes in Oceanside, and the only active single-family residence currently available on the sand.

results.remarks: Welcome to Ocean Lofts, an exclusive community of modern loft residences just steps from the beach in the heart of Downtown Oceanside! This unique residence is configured as a 2 bedroom, 1 bath and offers incredible versatility with its modern loft design. Expansive windows and soaring ceilings create a bright, airy interior, while the flexible floor plan provides endless possibilities to personalize the space for your lifestyle. Whether envisioned as a full-time residence, coastal second home, or beach getaway, this is a rare opportunity to enjoy a truly distinctive style of living by the ocean.  Built with concrete construction, Ocean Lofts features dramatic ceilings up to 20’ high, floor-to-ceiling windows, and an expansive ocean-view rooftop deck for lounging, al fresco dining, and taking in evening sunsets. The building’s contemporary, industrial-inspired design offers a living experience unlike anything else in the area.  Step outside and enjoy everything that makes Downtown Oceanside one of Southern California’s most exciting coastal destinations. Michelin-starred restaurants, trendy coffee shops, craft breweries, rooftop lounges, and weekly sunset markets are all within a short walk. Spend the day at the beach, rent kayaks or paddle boards at the nearby Oceanside Harbor, or stroll out to the world-famous Oceanside Pier.  On-site amenities include a fitness center, spacious private storage lockers, central A/C, in-unit laundry, and assigned parking. A rare opportunity to own a versatile modern loft where the beach, dining, entertainment, and vibrant Downtown Oceanside lifestyle are right outside your door.

results.remarks: Experience coastal living at its finest in this beautifully remodeled beach condo, perfectly positioned in the highly sought-after North Coast Village. Enjoy whitewater ocean views from both balconies, with the expansive upper balcony offering the perfect retreat to watch sailboats drift by and catch glimpses of sea life. Spanning the 3rd and 4th floors of the desirable C building, this residence features a living area with a tiled fireplace and tasteful furnishings, including a queen sofa bed and 2 recliners. The kitchen offers sleek countertops, recessed lighting, stone-look flooring, and refreshed cabinets. North Coast Village offers an unbeatable resort-style lifestyle, complete with two heated pools and spas, putting green, ocean-view BBQ area, and lush tropical landscaping throughout. Stay active in the fully equipped gym, unwind in the saunas, and enjoy the peace of mind that comes with 24-hour gated and guarded security. Reserved garage parking is also included. This home is being sold mostly furnished, making it a true turnkey opportunity to embrace the beach lifestyle.  As you walk through the staffed secure gate to North Coast Village you are transported to a tropical oasis reminiscent of the Costa Rican Rain Forest. Running streams, waterfalls, lush foliage, and Koi make their way through the spacious grounds of this resort-like beachfront condominium complex in Oceanside California. You will notice the crystal clear heated pool and spa, gleaming barbecues, convenient picnic tables, sand rinsing stations to remove the lingering beach. If you need a break from sun and surf, you might enjoy a game of pool on one of North Coast Village's 2 new pool tables, a jog on a treadmill in the exercise room, a little ping pong, or a sauna. Feeding our giant Koi is a simple pleasure not to be missed during your Oceanside visit. When you venture all the way through the back gates, you find yourself on one of North San Diego County’s finest beaches: broad and flat, with volleyball and great surf breaks - right out back! To your right, you can walk or bike to Oceanside’s busy little harbor for a bite to eat or some boating, and to your left you can venture down the strand to southern California’s longest pier for some fishing (no license needed).  North Coast Village is close enough to walk to everything near the beach, so your car can stay in its secure underground parking spot - especially useful when beach parking becomes a premium in the summer. The Mainstreet Oceanside Farmer's Market is a delightful experience near the Pier which takes place every Thursday from 9-1, and and the Sunset Market Thursday evenings from 5-9. Check out the many new restaurants, shops, and hotels in downtown Oceanside!

results.remarks: Welcome to Ocean Lofts, an exclusive community of modern loft residences just steps from the beach in the heart of Downtown Oceanside! This unique corner unit is currently configured as a 2 bedroom and offers incredible versatility with its modern loft design. Expansive windows and soaring ceilings create a bright, airy interior, while the flexible floor plan provides endless possibilities to personalize the space for your lifestyle. Whether envisioned as a full-time residence, coastal second home, or beach getaway, this is a rare opportunity to enjoy a truly distinctive style of living by the ocean.  Built with concrete construction, Ocean Lofts features dramatic ceilings up to 20’ high, floor-to-ceiling windows, and an expansive ocean view rooftop deck for lounging, al fresco dining, and taking in evening sunsets. The building’s contemporary industrial-inspired design offers a living experience unlike anything else in the area.  Step outside and enjoy everything that makes Downtown Oceanside one of Southern California’s most exciting coastal destinations. Michelin-starred restaurants, trendy coffee shops, craft breweries, rooftop lounges, and weekly sunset markets are all within a short walk. Spend the day at the beach, rent kayaks or paddle boards at the nearby Oceanside Harbor, or stroll out to the world-famous Oceanside Pier.  Ocean Lofts offers the flexibility of live/work zoning while functioning beautifully as a modern coastal residence. On-site amenities include a fitness center, spacious private storage lockers, central A/C, in-unit laundry, and assigned parking. A rare opportunity to own a versatile corner loft where the beach, dining, entertainment, and vibrant Downtown Oceanside lifestyle are right outside your door.

results.remarks: You’ll love this classic family home with its charming white picket fence and welcoming curb appeal! Nestled in a quiet, family-friendly neighborhood with wide streets and sidewalks, this spacious 4-bedroom, 3-bath home offers plenty of room to grow. Enjoy the convenience of an entry-level bedroom and full bath—perfect for guests or multigenerational living. The bright kitchen overlooks the family room, creating a warm and open space for gathering. Dual-pane windows, vaulted ceilings, and durable flooring add comfort and style throughout. Step outside to a large, fully fenced front yard where kids and pets can play safely, and a private backyard with fruit trees—no neighbors peeking in! Practical upgrades include a roof replacement around 2016 and fully owned solar panels that typically eliminate monthly electric bills. Ideally located near excellent schools, shopping, and dining—just five miles from the beach—this home captures the best of Southern California living. Enjoy easy access to golf courses, the San Luis Rey bike trail, Downtown Oceanside, the Pier, and the Harbor. No HOA fees or Mello-Roos—just classic coastal living in a home that truly has it all.

results.remarks: Every day feels like a vacation at 400 N The Strand #7, where ocean views and coastal breezes define the experience. This rare front-row, ground-floor corner  unit in the highly sought-after San Miguel III community offers true beachfront living. Enjoy no stairs and single-level convenience.  Witness stunning white water ocean views and the soothing sound of waves from both the main living/kitchen area AND the primary suite. The desirable corner location provides added privacy and an abundance of natural light throughout. Featuring a spacious floor plan and boasting two ocean-view balconies, creating seamless indoor-outdoor living and multiple spaces to relax and take in the Pacific. The primary suite offers a peaceful retreat with generous space, a walk-in closet, and an en-suite bathroom.  Additional highlights include in-unit laundry and two assigned underground parking spaces in a gated garage. San Miguel III features beautifully maintained grounds, two spas, and convenient beach access points.  Located just a short stroll to the iconic Oceanside Pier, marina, and vibrant downtown, this home offers amazing walkability to Oceanside’s best dining, coffee shops, and boutique shopping.   Whether you're seeking a full-time residence or a second home, this is a rare opportunity to own along one of Southern California’s most desirable stretches of coastline.
